thread:
sam: Postmortem follow-up for the resume-loop issue. Root cause: clients retried resumes during brief infra flaps resulting in duplicate partial frames and some timeouts. We need action owners/timelines.

meera: agree. top areas: 1) SDK retry/backoff, 2) server handshake dedupe, 3) metrics/alerts, 4) customer scan + canary.

dan: I'll own SDK changes. Plan: add jittered exponential backoff, cap retries to 4 within 20s, and add `resume_quiet` boolean to delay immediate resume after flaky disconnect. Target PR 2026-04-07.

meera: I'll take server dedupe. Proposal: handshake_nonce + short Redis key (TTL 4s) and host-local cache fallback to avoid extra RTT. Design note by 2026-04-01, PR by 2026-04-13.

sam: metrics: add `stream.partials` and `stream.finalized` counters with labels {route,model,customer}, and an alert when partials > finalized by 5 in any 5m window. I'll open RD-4201 for dashboards; PR by 2026-04-05.

qa-runner: I'll prepare canary plan and QA harness script that simulates flaky connections. Can run verification by 2026-04-16. Need expected log markers from Dan/Meera: e.g., `resume.attempt` and `handshake.dedupe`.

dan: sample SDK snippet I'll include in PR: `retryDelay = Math.min(2000 * 2**attempt, 5000) * (1 + Math.random()*0.25)` and emit `resume.attempt` log.

meera: sample server pseudocode I'll include in design doc and benchmark latency with and without local LRU. Key: `hand:%s:%s` -> Redis set nx ttl=4s. If exists return existing session id.

sam: tickets and owners: RD-4210 Dan SDK backoff (PR 2026-04-07), RD-4211 Meera handshake dedupe (design 2026-04-01 PR 2026-04-13), RD-4201 Sam metrics+alerts (PR 2026-04-05), RD-4212 QA-runner canary run (verify 2026-04-16), RD-4213 Sam recurrence scan + customer tagging weekly x4 starting 2026-04-01.

dan: noted. I'll include rollback steps in SDK PR in case partial regressions occur.

meera: perf note: test TTLs 3s/4s/6s to find best trade-off; include microbench results in PR.

qa-runner: canary checklist (high level): 1) run flaky harness 2) assert no session has >1 partial without finalized within 30s 3) check resume.attempt counts per session 4) validate dashboard metrics.

sam: reconvene 2026-04-17 14:00 UTC for verification. if any dates slip update ticket and ping thread.

dan: ack, starting SDK branch today.

meera: ack, drafting design doc.

infra-bot: Tag applied: "resume-loop-2026-03"; followups RD-4201, RD-4210..RD-4213 created.

sam: thanks team, please update ticket fields (owner, due_date, verification steps) and paste PR links here when ready.
